text:
IncidentBot: :rotating_light: Pager 1327 triggered — inference-prod high tail latency (5xx rate > 3% over 5m). Primary listed as Asha but seems unavailable. Runbook: https://runbooks.redwood.ai/latency-spike — please coordinate cover and assess customer impact.

Asha: hey all, really sorry — family emergency came up, can't take the 00:00-04:00 UTC primary tonight. I tried to swap but it's last-minute. I can hand off notes + creds in DM. :disappointed:

Ben: ack. I'm in APAC so likely out ~23:30-07:00 UTC. can shadow earlier but can't commit full midnight slot. @Priya @Marco can either of you take primary?

Priya: I can take primary for 00:00-04:00 UTC tonight. I have PD access and KMS read for model keys. Will need a deputy for immediate escalation.

Marco: I can be secondary/deputy 00:00-04:00 UTC and stay on the bridge if needed. volunteer: yes. Leaving a short handoff checklist below.

Lena: quick checklist for last-minute coverage:
1) Claim the primary shift in PagerDuty (assign yourself to escalation policy).
2) Update the #eng-oncall pinned shift note and calendar event (so solutions knows who's on).
3) Pull the runbook and verify runbook steps + rollback commands.
4) Set temporary alert thresholds for quiet hours (so we don't miss noisy spikes).
5) If >10% errors or >500ms p50 sustained 5m -> open bridge and escalate to SRE lead.

Marco: handoff snippet i'll paste here so Priya has it quick:
```
# quick checks
curl -sS -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" "https://api.redwood.ai/metrics?team=inference&window=5m" | jq '."5xx_rate", .p50_latency_ms'
# rollback (if model change suspected)
redwood deploy rollback --model inference-model-prod --to inference-model-prod-v1 --env prod
# open bridge
/bridge create --severity high --topic "inference-prod latency"
```

Asha: Priya — thanks so much. i'll DM the short list of active eval prompts + the one-off token for the ops console. Also there's a small ongoing customer impact note: a handful of clients on model-v2 saw elevated latencies earlier tonight.

Priya: claimed primary in PagerDuty and updated the pinned note. I'll run a quick smoke test now and post results. :white_check_mark:

Ben: logged a quick customer-impact note in the incident tracker: ~0.8% of requests had >1s tail latency in last 30m. no soft SLA breaches yet but trending. if that hits 3% we open bridge.

Marco: set temporary alert: p95 > 700ms for 5m -> notify channel and page both primary+secondary. pushing config now.

Priya: smoke: model endpoints responding, sample generation < 150ms locally. watching metrics. i'll be on watch from 23:55 UTC. Marco can you verify the alert got applied?

Marco: alert applied and tested. watched a simulated spike, paged you and Asha test accounts worked. I'll stand by on the bridge.

Lena: small operational note: if you need to rotate keys or pull logs from private clusters use the emergency access steps in the runbook (page 2). Don't forget to mark the incident as "handoff-solo-cover" in the ticket if Asha can't flip back on duty.

Asha: thanks team. Priya + Marco — appreciate you covering last-minute. i'll follow up tomorrow morning to debrief. :pray:

IncidentBot: Reminder — when primary role is assumed manually, please add a one-line entry to the shift roster with PD user and UTC span. Also file any callbacks to customers in the incident ticket.

Priya: done — roster updated and incident ticket annotated with coverage note. I'll ping here if anything degrades. :thumbsup:

Marco: I'll take the bridge if we need it, otherwise will hand back to Asha in morning. GL everyone.
